target.statement: Mean AUC-PR of K-DSM on the ADBench semi-supervised benchmark (57 datasets, 5 seeds) = 0.627

compute.basis: Requires downloading ADBench (57 datasets, some large like cover/celeba), training an MLP DSM per dataset for 5 seeds, and averaging; CPU-feasible but many runs, so several hours of command time.

blockers: 57 datasets must be downloaded and preprocessed (ADBench pipeline)
Code repo may not include exact configs/splits; reproduction may need reimplementation
title: Kurtosis-Guided Denoising Score Matching for Tabular Anomaly Detection
